# linearctl file

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill-docs.py from --help; do not edit. -->

## linearctl file download

```
Download a file from uploads.linear.app (an image or attachment URL in an issue
or comment) with the API key, into the current directory.
--output defaults to the URL's last path segment. An existing file with the same
content is changed: false; with different content the command fails.
--dry-run downloads to memory and reports what --yes would write.
Changes things: pass --dry-run to preview, --yes to apply.

Usage:
  linearctl file download URL [flags]

Examples:
  linearctl file download https://uploads.linear.app/8f…/2c…/a1… --output shot.png --yes

Flags:
      --dry-run       show what would change; change nothing
  -h, --help          help for download
      --output PATH   write to PATH inside the current directory
      --yes           apply the change
```
